title: Finance Officer (LATAM)(m/f/x) - Rio de Janeiro - MSF Belgium
description:
Must be willing to travel for work as needed

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international humanitarian aid organization that provides assistance in more than 70 countries to populations in distress, to victims of natural or manmade disasters and to victims of armed conflicts, without discrimination and irrespective of origin, religion, creed or political affiliation.

CONTEXT

At the heart of the Operations Department in the Operational Centre of Brussels (OCB), the Cells are comprised of a multidisciplinary team of 7 people, including a Coordinator of Operations (CO), Deputy CO, Medical Officer, Human Resources Officer (HRO), Logistic Officer, Finance Officer, Supply Officer and a regional pharmacy advisor working remotely. Their role is to supervise and coordinate MSF activities in several countries. The Cells are the direct interface from HQ to international programmes. We are looking for a Finance Officer for Cell 5, based in Rio de Janeiro, managing the following countries: Haiti, Brazil, Venezuela and Dominican Republic.

As Finance Officer , you play a key strategic role in managing all finance‑and risk‑related domains. Embedded within the Operations Department and working closely with the Finance Department, you act as the Cell financial focal point, fully involved in operational decision‑making and familiar with all projects under the Cell’s portfolio.

As Finance Officer , you are responsible for the financial management of the programmes you oversee. This includes supporting, guiding, and coaching the Financial Coordinators (FinCos), ensuring the quality of management control, budgeting and forecasting, and risk resources management. You guarantee that financial analyses are accurate and aligned with MSF policies and processes. As a referent for FinCos, you promote optimal resource use and contribute to the organisation’s long‑term sustainability.

The countries assigned to the Cell are indicative, as a re‑shuffling of the portfolio within the operations department occurs on a regular basis.

The Finance Officer reports both to the Coordinator of Operations (line manager) and to the Operational Finance Coordinator (functional manager).

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Strategy and Support

Ensure the long‑term sustainability of the finance and risk resources strategies applied in the programmes to complete the constraints related to the shorter‑term assignment for the Finance Coordinators.

Advise, support and challenge the Cell members and CO (Coordinator of Operations) in the management of the operational allocation of resources.

Centralize and lead the programme budget process in close collaboration with Cell members, acting as the guarantor of consistency across yearly and multi‑year budgets.

Collaborate actively in new project proposals, providing financial expertise throughout the process.

Monitor closely the economic indicators of each country and their consequences, ensure that appropriate measures are taken, and oversee their implementation with the Finance Coordinator.

Advise, challenge, and make final decisions on the analytical structure of the budget and accounting (cost centre, budget line, activity, referent), ensuring it is tailored to the strategic orientation, the need operational reporting, and fits the programme’s financial capacity and maturity.

Ensure the pertinence of the Finance team set‑up of the programmes, designing it in line with the operational context, needs and objectives, and adapt the Finance team set‑up according to the evolution of the context and the related risk assessment.

Internal/Quality Control, Standards and Compliance

Contribute actively to the development and upgrade of tools, finance standards, guidelines, and procedures as a key stakeholder.

Ensure that the financial tools, processes and guidelines are relevant, appropriate and are managed according to the MSF OCB standardin the programmes.

Ensure the Programme Finance Guideline is regularly updated and accurate to reflect local compliance requirements, regulation standards, and contextual realities in each programme.

Guide and motivate the Finance Coordinators, and influence the programme and the Cell on risk resource‑management, and compliance analysis as well as on mitigation measures.

Drive the implementation, analysis, and follow‑up of the recommendations of the Internal Control Tool for Finance processes.

Drive the implementation and follow up of internal, external, and national audit recommendations.

Resources Management

Oversee the budget management of the Cell’s portfolio.

Manage the coherence of the multi‑year budget with the project cycle and strategy.

Manage the accuracy of the initial budget by leading the ARO‑MYRO (Annual Review of Operations - Multi‑Year Review of Operation) financial process to its final validation.

Mentor the monthly forecast or quarterly monitoring meeting of projects and programmes by guiding and challenging the programmes in their calculation, projections and analyses.

Ensure the validation process for budget and forecast decision is respected.

Risk resources management of the Cell’s portfolio

Adapt and implement the standard insurance guidelines to the national and legal context.

Implement and regularly review the money security policy, ensuring it is adapted to the operational reality and programme constraints.

Develop and maintain awareness of the anti‑corruption policy and related reporting mechanisms, followed by appropriate measures to ensure compliance.

Ensure the efficiency of the process of programmes provision for litigations and the quality of the information.

Availability of funds in the mission to run the operations

Design and implement in close collaboration with the Finance Coordinators, the finance strategy related means of payment (innovative solutions, online banking, phone banking, hawallah, cash providers, virtual credit cards, etc.).

Review and validate the monthly cash request for the Cell portfolio.

Stakeholders Coordination - Internal and External Communication and Representation

Guarantee efficient communication and a close, effective collaboration with the Programme Accounting Controller overseeing programme accounting support.

Provide the needed information to the Funding Unit related to donor reporting.

Ensure compliance with national fiscal legislation, in collaboration with the ILD (International Legal Department) and other relevant technical departments.

Revise and influence programmes’ agreements involving other sections, procurement centres and international service providers.

Stimulate, maintain, and develop the finance component of intersectional collaboration; promote and uphold mutualisation and harmonisation between sections; and lead the resolution of issues related to finance interoperability among OCs.

Work in close collaboration with the partner section MSF Brazil (MSFBR), especially with its Finance Department, on accounting and tax‑related matters in Brazil, as the position is based in the country and the Cell supports operations locally.

People Management, Supervision and Development

Develop, collaborate on, and facilitate Finance trainings, webinars, and FinCo Weeks.

Anticipate and build the vision for developing key finance staff in programmes, taking into account the national context.

Coach, advise, and develop the competencies of the Financial Coordinators, and provide feedback in close collaboration with their line manager; steer the priority‑setting process in line with departmental strategy; monitor performance along the programme.

Enable a conducive environment within the finance department to foster good team dynamics.

Brief and debrief coordination members before and after their programme deployments.

Treasury Management for the Cell

Manage the Cell’s treasury, including the preparation and submission of the cash request through WeFin.

Oversee the approval of payments, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness.

Manage the Cell’s bank account(s), ensuring proper liquidity levels, reconciliation, and alignment with MSF financial standards and procedures.

Budgeting and Forecasting

Coordinate actively with the HQ Controlling team on budget and forecasting activities, addressing queries related to expense variances and incurred costs at Cell level.

Serve as the primary contact for the HQ Controlling team on budget and forecast matters, regarding, ensuring timely and accurate responses to expense‑related inquiries.

Prepare the Cell’s annual budget in WeFin, in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

Produce and update the Cell’s forecast, ensuring realistic planning and alignment with operational priorities.

Monitor budget execution and provide financial analysis to ensure correct and compliant use of budget lines.

Accounting Follow Up

Monitor the Cell’s accounting, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal policies.

Support and monitor the accurate booking of all expenditures against the appropriate budget lines.

Ensure timely reporting and consolidation of financial information at the regional level.

REQUIREMENTS

Education & Experience

University degree in management, business administration or finance (bachelor’s degree level) or equivalent professional experience.

Minimum 3 years of experience in finance management is mandatory , with MSF or another similar International Humanitarian Organisation (INGO).

Minimum 1 year of International MSF experience in different contexts and interventions , at least one experience as a Financial Coordinator is mandatory .

Capacity to learn and use advanced financial tools.

Strong knowledge in risks resources and internal control management.

Advanced knowledge of Excel, Power BI, MS Office package.

Comprehensive knowledge of humanitarian environment and operations.

Analytical Thinking.

Result‑oriented, with strong problem‑solving skills.

Planning and organising, can work under stress and capacity to prioritize.

Capacity to negotiate, with strong diplomacy and persuasive skills.

Effective in teamwork and collaboration, showing strong awareness of cross‑cultural dynamics.

Flexibility and adaptability.

Demonstrates creativity and innovation, with the capacity to take proactive initiatives.

Languages

  • Proficiency in at least two of the regional languages : French, Spanish, or Portuguese is mandatory .

CONDITIONS

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager , the Ticketing Electronic Access Control Manager oversees the Ticketing Electronic Access Control project for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Ticketing Operations team in Zurich as well as other key individuals responsible for the delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

  • Manage the Ticketing Electronic Access Control (TEAC) project for ticket holders in close collaboration with all relevant stakeholders;

  • Issue access control documentations and organize workshops, tests and inspections with all relevant parties;
  • Support the definition of flow data for ticket holders and define access rules based on available variables and according to operational concept and established flow data;
  • Monitor the access control interfaces and facilitate issue resolution with all relevant parties;
  • Setup the ticketing system to support access control testing (integration, stadium and match day);
  • Support the mobile ticketing project and provide required support for configuration, deployment, testing and maintenance;
  • Prepare training materials and deliver trainings in preparation of match day operations;
  • Oversee and coordinate the operations of several access control venue staff during the tournament;
  • Monitor the access control interfaces and data exchange, as well as facilitate issue resolution with relevant parties;
  • Reporting on data exchange and Match Day operation;
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events

  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education

  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities

  • Strong analytical skills, detail-oriented, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones

Certifications & Requirements

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Human Rights Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on human rights-related topics.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the oversight and implementation of the tournament’s human rights strategy, including the human rights grievance mechanism.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage the development and delivery of key Sustainability Strategy initiatives to:

  • Embed respect for human rights across the tournament organisation and ensure a robust human rights due diligence process in accordance with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights
  • Develop and implement initiatives in particular in the fields of labour rights and anti-discrimination with a view to ensuring respect for labour rights in supply chains for the event as well as an inclusive tournament experience for everyone
  • Manage the follow up on grievances associated with the tournament received through FIFA’s human rights grievance mechanisms
  • Working with multiple other functional areas to embed respect for human rights across their policies, procedures and activities
  • Coordinating a meaningful engagement process with human rights stakeholders in Brazil
  • Supporting communications efforts on human rights-related topics.

As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2023™ Sustainability Team:

  • Support the maintenance of an effective sustainability management system for the tournament in line with the requirements of ISO 20121, including the development and implementation of action plans and operational processes, capacity building, stakeholder engagement and communication, monitoring and evaluation of performance, and reporting and knowledge transfer.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination Department and the FIFA Sustainability & Environment Department based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

YOUR PROFILE

Minimum requirements:

  • A deep passion for human rights, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices;
  • Deep familiarity with international human rights standards and in particular the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights;
  • 5 years of work experience implementing human rights-related programmes;
  • Experience of working in complex, fixed timeline, multi-stakeholder environments;
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes;
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication; and
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and conducting internet-based research.

Candidates with experience in the following areas will have an advantage:

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, political science and/or international relations;
  • In-depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega-sporting events;
  • Familiarity with human rights-related legal requirements in Brazil of relevance to the competition;
  • Familiarity with Corporate Social Responsibility ISO 26000 and / or AA1000 Stakeholder Engagement Standards;
  • Developing and delivering capacity-building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders;
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications;
  • Working in sports and/or events; and International work experience.

Unique knowledge and skills:

  • Quick learner with ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe;
  • Self-motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate;
  • Strong communication skills (both verbal and written);
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills;
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds; and
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio-political and sustainability issues.

You can expect a highly knowledgeable, motivated and helpful team working in a dynamic multicultural environment.

description:
Valorizamos a candidatura de Pessoas com deficiência, Pessoas negras, Pessoas LGBTI+, Pessoas 45+ e Mulheres!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsável por executar e/ou monitorar o cumprimento de todos requisitos legais de segurança do trabalho aplicáveis à companhia (Ex: PGR, CIPA, Brigada de Emergência, etc.), visando o atendimento legal e a minimização/eliminação do impacto dos riscos à saúde das partes relacionadas.

Principais Atividades

  • Realizar a análise de acidentes ou quase acidentes, fornecendo diretrizes e metodologia de análise para determinar as causas dos mesmos, visando o bloqueio e/ou neutralização através de propostas de medidas de controle;
  • Prestar apoio técnico às áreas, sempre com foco no atendimento legal e na segurança e integridade física dos envolvidos;
  • Realizar e participar de inspeções dos mais diversos temas relacionados à segurança;
  • Realizar e participar de auditorias de certificação bem como de averiguações internas;
  • Controlar e reportar os indicadores das regiões de sua responsabilidade;
  • Aplicar treinamentos, sempre que necessário;
  • Desenvolver e implementar procedimentos de gestão de segurança do trabalho;
  • Participar ativamente da concepção e do evento da SIPAT (Semana Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalho);
  • Atuar na avaliação do cumprimento dos requisitos legais dos contratados e subcontratados, inclusive de suas liberações para execução das atividades, bem como controlar a ocorrência de acidentes ou quase acidentes dos mesmos;
  • Promover a realização anual dos simulados de emergência das edificações das regiões que fiquem sob a sua responsabilidade, conforme PAE (Programa de Atendimento à Emergências) também construído internamente pelo profissional, com suporte dos engenheiros de segurança do trabalho;
  • Compor, manter e acompanhar de perto a atuação das CIPAs (Comissões Internas de Prevenção de Acidentes).

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Desejada: Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho
  • Sólida experiência na área
  • Experiência atuando em grandes empresas e, preferencialmente com grande capilaridade nacional;
  • Experiência de campo e em desenvolvimento ou implementação de processos e indicadores de gestão; Experiência em processos de emergência, principalmente relacionados à proteção e combate a incêndios.
  • Fundamentos de ESG.

Informações adicionais

Na TIM, o seu bem-estar é o nosso bem-estar, por isso o programa Conexão Bem + Estar tem o propósito de fortalecer o cuidado genuíno da TIM com o TIMe e suas famílias, por meio de iniciativas práticas em diversas frentes para todos e todas estarem sempre bem, na vida pessoal e profissional.

title: TECNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO - SMS
description:
Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI ́s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar e analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Registro MTE.
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Jornada: escala 12x36 (diurno ou noturno)

description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia‑Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho que será responsável pela gestão de saúde e segurança das obras e projetos, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposta para mitigação dos riscos de saúde e segurança e o atendimento à legislação vigente.

Responsabilidades

  • Identificar, analisar e mitigar os riscos ocupacionais associados às atividades das frentes de serviço, implementando medidas preventivas e corretivas para reduzir os riscos de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais.
  • Elaborar e coordenar os processos/procedimentos de segurança de obras, seguindo o direcional do programa de integração de SSMA, elaboração de planos de ação, treinamentos e gestão dos requisitos legais, objetivando o cumprimento das devidas normas.
  • Atendimento aos requisitos legais de saúde e segurança relativos às frentes de serviços da NTS pautadas nas Normas Regulamentadoras, leis municipais, estaduais e federais.
  • Realizar treinamentos e outras comunicações para funcionários NTS sobre documentos internos e outros processos relativos a saúde e segurança, com objetivo de capacitá-los e conscientizá-los sobre a importância do cuidado ativo genuíno.
  • Realizar Integração de SSMA para prestadores de serviço antes do início de suas atividades para NTS, com o objetivo de apresentar os riscos das atividades, política e norma NTS e a importância de gerenciar riscos e desenvolver comportamentos seguros.
  • Realizar Briefing de segurança para todos aqueles que nunca acessaram as instalações da NTS, conscientizando-os dos riscos existentes em cada área visitada e como proceder em emergências.
  • Contribuir ativamente na gestão do Sistema de Gestão Integrado da NTS, incentivando o processo de melhoria contínua, ajustando procedimentos para refletir a realidade de campo.
  • Atuar como suporte nos cenários de resposta à emergência nas frentes da NTS, participando dos simulados de emergência, definindo junto as áreas plano de ação eficaz para reduzir e/ou eliminar os perigos existentes nas atividades / instalações da NTS.
  • Seguir as diretrizes de gerenciamento de incidentes, de acordo com as classificações da NTS, disseminar alertas de incidentes com a força de trabalho do campo, principalmente quanto aos incidentes de alto potencial e suas tratativas.
  • Gerir as não conformidades e planos de ação das suas frentes, de acordo com os procedimentos NTS.
  • Seguir as diretrizes da NTS quanto ao gerenciamento de inspeções e auditorias.
  • Realizar inspeções e auditorias periódicas com objetivo de avaliar a gestão em SSMA.
  • Atuar conforme periodicidade definida no procedimento de observação de segurança (auditoria comportamental).

Requisitos

  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes com veículo da empresa.
  • Experiência em construção civil e projetos.
  • Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho completo.
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.

Benefícios

  • Bolsa‑auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio‑medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale‑presente, Vale‑transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.

title: Gerente Tecnico de Engenharia Subsea
description:
Descrição para Candidatos Internos

Pessoas notáveis, confiáveis pelos clientes para projetar e avançar o mundo.

Sobre a Vaga

A Wood está recrutando para o cargo de Gerente Técnico de Engenharia (Subsea) para se juntar ao negócio de Consultoria , focando em Subsea . Esta oportunidade é híbrida em Rio de Janeiro, RJ .

A Wood está buscando um Gerente Técnico de Engenharia (Subsea) para assumir a responsabilidade pela entrega técnica segura e eficiente de projetos subsea de O&G multidisciplinares. Esta função terá responsabilidade direta pela gestão da entrega técnica de equipes de engenharia multidisciplinares para projetos subsea de O&G greenfield e brownfield. Atuará na gestão de engenharia, entregando grandes projetos subsea de O&G nas fases de pré‑FEED, FEED e execução.

O que podemos oferecer

  • Projetos significativos e interessantes entregues a líderes da indústria.
  • Arranjos de trabalho flexíveis que equilibram as necessidades do cliente, da equipe e individuais. Esta oportunidade é híbrida em Rio de Janeiro, RJ.
  • Compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão em toda a nossa empresa.
  • Salário competitivo com revisões salariais regulares.
  • Pacote de benefícios flexíveis que pode ser adaptado para se adequar ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Compromisso com o desenvolvimento profissional contínuo através de planos de desenvolvimento personalizados.
  • Conexões globais com os principais especialistas da indústria ao redor do mundo.

Em nosso processo de contratação, estendemos nossas oportunidades a pessoas com deficiência (PCD), promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e acessível para todos.

Qualificações para Candidatos Internos

Na Wood, estamos comprometidos com oportunidades iguais e convidamos todos os indivíduos talentosos a considerar se juntar à nossa equipe. Portanto, mesmo que você não corresponda a todas as declarações abaixo, mas sinta que possui alguma experiência, conhecimento ou habilidades necessárias para esta função, incentivamos você a se candidatar. Será necessário que todos nós trabalhemos juntos para entregar soluções aos desafios mais críticos do mundo.

Responsibilities

  • Gerenciar equipe de engenharia subsea multidisciplinar para entregar, de forma segura e eficiente, os entregáveis acordados, cronograma e orçamento.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades realizadas pela equipe do projeto sejam concluídas utilizando os processos e procedimentos aprovados do SGQ (Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade), promovendo a excelência técnica nos projetos.
  • Apoiar e supervisionar a execução de alta qualidade das tarefas atribuídas à equipe.
  • Gerenciar o escopo de engenharia, identificando quaisquer desvios e participando do processo de MOC (Gestão de Mudanças).
  • Gerenciar as principais partes interessadas (stakeholders) na execução e entrega das atividades do projeto.
  • Gerenciar e direcionar os recursos de engenharia de forma eficiente e eficaz.
  • Coordenar a entrega técnica e a garantia da qualidade do projeto.
  • Coordenar a interface entre a equipe do projeto e os gerentes funcionais das disciplinas de engenharia.
  • Reportar regularmente e com precisão o progresso da equipe de engenharia por meio dos protocolos estabelecidos.
  • Corrigir qualquer desempenho abaixo do esperado e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Auxiliar na identificação e solicitação de suporte funcional ao projeto, conforme necessário.
  • Promover a cultura e o desempenho em HSSEA (Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Responsabilidade Social) junto à equipe do projeto.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de negócios na compreensão das necessidades dos clientes, fatores direcionadores, desafios e objetivos de negócio, a fim de comercializar e garantir novos escopos de trabalho ou extensões contratuais.
  • Elaborar propostas técnicas para projetos subsea, estimar recursos e horas‑homem necessárias para entregar um determinado escopo e apoiar a equipe local de Crescimento e Desenvolvimento na prospecção de novos clientes e projetos.
  • Liderar a elaboração de propostas competitivas, conforme necessário, apoiando esclarecimentos e interfaces de acompanhamento com clientes para maximizar a probabilidade de sucesso da Wood na obtenção de contratos/projetos.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de procedimentos operacionais em todas as etapas do trabalho.
  • Gestão e administração de projetos.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as equipes de Consultoria de Houston e do Rio de Janeiro.

Descrição da vaga

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Quais serão seus desafios:

  • Desenvolver o conceito e a estratégia de campanhas de incentivo (viagens, experiências, premiações e eventos proprietários);
  • Traduzir objetivos de negócio em mecânicas de incentivo claras, atrativas e mensuráveis;
  • Definir KPIs de sucesso (engajamento, performance, ROI e satisfação);
  • Liderar projetos de eventos e campanhas do início ao fim;
  • Estruturar cronogramas, fluxos e governança com stakeholders internos;
  • Garantir alinhamento com áreas como marketing, comercial, jurídico e financeiro;
  • Selecionar, negociar e gerenciar agências, DMCs, hotéis e fornecedores de produção e logística;
  • Assegurar excelência na entrega, cumprimento de SLA e otimização de custos;
  • Atuar com visão crítica sobre propostas (escopo, custos, riscos e alternativas);
  • Elaborar e controlar budgets detalhados, com visão analítica e transparência de custos;
  • Acompanhar despesas por centro de custo, garantindo aderência ao planejado;
  • Buscar eficiência financeira sem comprometer a experiência;
  • Garantir a entrega impecável dos eventos (logística, conteúdo e experiência do participante);
  • Atuar presencialmente em eventos, gerenciando operação, fornecedores e imprevistos;
  • Supervisionar conteúdos (roteiros, apresentações, ativações e experiências);
  • Criar jornadas memoráveis para os participantes (pré, durante e pós-evento);
  • Desenvolver ações de relacionamento, reconhecimento e pertencimento;
  • Garantir comunicação clara, consistente e atrativa em todos os pontos de contato;
  • Analisar resultados das campanhas (KPIs, feedbacks e ROI);
  • Propor melhorias e inovações para ciclos futuros;

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean PolicyConservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.POSITION SUMMARYThis position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, PeruOver the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity;
and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.RESPONSIBILITIESInternational Ocean Policy- Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.- Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.- Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.- Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.- Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.G., side events, meetings with countries and partners).- Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries- In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.- Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.- As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.- Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.Blue Climate Program- Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.- Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.Other duties as assigned by supervisor.WORKING CONDITIONS- Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.- Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.- Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.- Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.QUALIFICATIONSRequired- Bachelor’s degree- 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.- Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.- Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.- Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.- Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.- Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.- Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.- Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.- Fluency in written and spoken English.Preferred- Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.- Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions- Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.- Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.See all Conservation International Career Opportunities HEREConservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.Senior Legal CounselMain responsibilities- Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.- Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.- Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.- Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.- Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.- Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.- Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.- Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.- Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.Required qualifications- Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.- Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.- Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English;
ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.- Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.Preferred experience- Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.- Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.- Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.- Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.- Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.What success looks like in this role- Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.- Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.- Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.- Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities;
everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on

Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team. Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues. Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise. Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction. Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery. The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities. Education Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree. Knowledge & Skills This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts. Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset. Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment. Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters. Excellent public speaking and presentation skills. Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software. Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset. Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English. Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil. Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers. Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English. Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required. No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us! We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG. title: Assembly And After-Sales Support Technician
description: Job Description Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required Reports to: Account Manager and CTO Contract Type: CLT About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations. Position Summary: The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively. Position duties and responsibilities: Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality. Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance. Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support. Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms. Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively. Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups. Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations. Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities. Qualification and requirements: Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules. Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting. Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting. Strong problem-solving skills Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills. Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication. Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments. Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus. Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued. LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion. Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps: Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to   with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician. Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English. Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps. Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Crewing Assistant
description: About the Role We are looking for a Crewing Assistant to support our growing operations in Brazil. With two vessels now active in the region, we are strengthening our crewing team to ensure smooth, compliant, and timely crew management. In this role, you will support crew changes, documentation, training arrangements, onboarding, and flag‑state applications. You will work closely with the Crew Planner, Crewing Coordinator, and Crewing Officer to ensure all crew joining our vessels are fully prepared and compliant. What You Will Do Support the processing of flag-state applications (endorsements, seaman’s books, etc.) Coordinate visa requests and travel documentation for crew Assist in preparing and processing POs for crew changes and training Handle documentation for onboarding and pre-employment checks Ensure all data is accurately recorded and kept up to date in the system Liaise with internal teams to support crew scheduling and logistics What You Bring Strong attention to detail and accuracy Experience in administrative roles, preferably in crewing or maritime operations Knowledge of STCW, MLC, ISM, ISPS, CBA, and flag-state regulations (preferred) Proficiency in English Ability to work with standard office equipment and systems Ability to coordinate multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment Why Join Us This is an opportunity to be part of a growing regional team supporting key operational activities. You will play an essential role in ensuring our crews are prepared, compliant, and ready to sail.

title: Especialista Em Design De Calçados
description: Especialista em Design de Calçados Localização: Rio de Janeiro – RJ I. A Missão da Posição O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time. II. Responsabilidades Principais Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados. Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance. Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce. Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio. Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca. Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos. III. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios. Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes. Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores. Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado. Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas. IV. Diferenciais Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure. Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design. Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento. Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Auxiliar De Cozinha
description: Este curso gratuito de culinária oferecerá uma visão geral abrangente de várias habilidades de preparo de alimentos, métodos de cocção e técnicas mais avançadas. Um dos muitos fundamentos para um chef é aprender a fazer caldo, componente essencial em muitos pratos e base para diversos molhos. Entenda por que, após preparar um caldo, é essencial seguir os métodos corretos de resfriamento, armazenamento e reaquecimento para evitar o crescimento de bactérias. Em seguida, descubra a importância dos molhos na união dos ingredientes e na explosão de sabor. A carne é o centro de muitas cozinhas, pratos e preparações, por isso é importante conhecer as três categorias nas quais a carne doméstica é geralmente dividida. Qual delas costuma ser a mais valorizada e com maior preço? Como a qualidade varia conforme o tipo de animal de origem? De que forma os criadores modificaram certas carnes para que sejam mais magras e com menos gordura? Alguns tipos de carne podem conter parasitas específicos que representam riscos sérios à saúde? Aves e frutos do mar também são ingredientes populares e, assim como a carne, são fontes importantes de proteína. O primeiro grupo inclui ao menos oito tipos diferentes de aves, e o curso detalha as partes mais e menos populares. Também aborda o que observar na escolha de frutos do mar e como identificar se estão frescos. Eviscerar peixes corretamente é uma habilidade essencial para todos os cozinheiros, e o material mostrará como realizar esse processo de forma adequada para evitar que as vísceras liberem enzimas que deterioram rapidamente o peixe. Você estudará os tipos, a anatomia e o preparo de moluscos e cefalópodes, integrantes também do grupo dos frutos do mar. Por fim, conhecerá a variedade de\ "acompanhamentos\", incluindovegetais, grãos e massas. Saiba como cultivamos grãos por séculos, como trigo, arroz, quinoa e cevada, e entenda por que a massa pode ser considerada parte da família dos grãos. Aprenda como a combinação de farinha com ovos ou água gera a massa e por que a massa fresca proporciona sabores mais intensos. Por último, o curso aborda sobremesas, muitas das quais exigem técnicas altamente especializadas para serem executadas corretamente. Seja a base de chocolate ou baunilha, servidas quentes ou frias, dominar a preparação de diversas sobremesas é fundamental para ser um cozinheiro ou chef completo. Este curso é ideal para quem deseja aprimorar suas habilidades culinárias, seja um cozinheiro doméstico ou um chef profissional iniciante. Ao dominar as técnicas essenciais contidas neste curso, você estará apto a criar seus próprios pratos, contando com uma base sólida de métodos e conhecimentos sobre caldos, molhos, carnes, acompanhamentos e sobremesas. Também aprenderá a reduzir desperdícios alimentares e, se administrar um restaurante ou empresa de catering, verá como o armazenamento e preparo adequados podem aumentar seu lucro bruto. Pais que ficam em casa, estudantes, babás e cuidadores também podem se beneficiar ao concluir este curso valioso de habilidades e técnicas culinárias.

This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.
