.Controlar adiantamentos de fornecedores, solicitando NFs referentes a entregas e serviços;
.Enviar contratos para assinatura digital e realizar liberação no Sienge após conferência dos documentos;

.Acompanhar relatórios de distorção por apropriação e de saldos de credores, cobrando notas fiscais de fornecedores já pagos por adiantamento;

.Excel intermediário ou avançado;

.Conhecimento em processos de medição e apropriação de custos;
.Vivência em relacionamento direto com clientes corporativos e processos de auditoria financeira. title: Coordenador(A) Comercial - Soluções Financeiras Para Faculdades
description: Entusiasmo, compromisso e perseverança são três elementos importantes da liderança, que conduzem a um trabalho em equipe eficaz entre colegas dedicados. Equipes de sucesso são caracterizadas por um espírito de equipe baseado na confiança, respeito mútuo, prestatividade e cordialidade. Neste breve curso de treinamento em gestão, estudamos os princípios e práticas comuns a equipes de alto desempenho. O curso explica como líderes podem incutir otimismo, garantir o uso eficiente dos recursos e aumentar o moral e desempenho da equipe. Estudamos diferentes tipos de equipes e identificamos as melhores práticas para estabelecer normas de grupo na organização. Demonstramos como desenvolver planos estratégicos, táticos, operacionais e de contingência para levar sua equipe através de qualquer situação difícil. Em seguida, abordamos vários estilos de liderança para ajudar a refinar suas interações e influenciar colegas a darem seu melhor. Aprenda a usar as habilidades sociais para fomentar o trabalho em equipe, gerenciar conflitos e construir confiança. Este curso foi projetado para ajudar você a desenvolver as habilidades conceituais necessárias para analisar situações complexas pensando\ "fora da caixa\". Apresentamos os sete indicadores-chave de alta motivação e explicamos como aplicá-los no ambiente de trabalho para motivar seus colegas. Também exploramos a gestão de talentos, estresse, saúde mental e planejamento de sucessão, pois a\ "liderança transformacional\"exige uma abordagem holística para atender às necessidades dos colaboradores. O curso oferece ainda dicas práticas para dominar técnicas de negociação, gestão de tempo e conflito, gestão de riscos e coordenação de equipes virtuais. Inscreva-se para adquirir as habilidades de liderança transformadora que levarão sua equipe a novos patamares e impulsionarão sua carreira.

title: Enfermeiro (Gastroenterologia) - Hospital Cardoso Fontes
description: Este curso gratuito de enfermagem vai introduzi-lo inicialmente aos cuidados perioperatórios e pré-operatórios do paciente. Você aprenderá o impacto que a intervenção cirúrgica pode ter no paciente e como isso pode exigir adaptações físicas e psicossociais para o paciente e sua família. Estudará as razões para as intervenções cirúrgicas e também explorará as classificações e descritores relacionados a elas. O curso também abordará os fatores que podem causar estresse psicológico nos pacientes. Em seguida, o curso discutirá o papel da enfermagem durante a fase intraoperatória e na sala de recuperação. Você aprenderá sobre os descritores usados para classificar os procedimentos cirúrgicos, que incluem ablativo, diagnóstico, construtivo, reconstrutivo, paliativo e transplante. O curso discutirá a equipe cirúrgica, incluindo o cirurgião, anestesiologista, enfermeiro instrumentador e enfermeiro circulante, além de explorar seus papéis chave no processo cirúrgico. A cirurgia é um procedimento invasivo que pode ser muito difícil para qualquer paciente. Independentemente da necessidade ou da complexidade da cirurgia, qualquer procedimento que imponha estresse físico e psicológico raramente é considerado\ "menor\" pelo paciente. Comoenfermeiro, a capacidade de fornecer o cuidado adequado para pacientes nessa situação é um poder valioso. Ao fazer este curso, você aprenderá o que é necessário para ajudar os pacientes a enfrentarem essa experiência difícil. Essa é uma habilidade verdadeiramente significativa.

If your background is primarily in those areas, this position is a different discipline and will likely not be a good fit. Our US fintech client — an online consumer lender — is looking for a Credit Risk Analyst who owns the front end of the credit funnel: designing risk tiers, sequencing underwriting decisions, managing approval/decline trade-offs, and building the logic that determines who gets credit and at what terms. If you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you If you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you. What You'll Do Own and iterate credit acquisition policies inside an automated decisioning engine Build and validate scorecards;
monitor performance through vintage analysis and population stability Segment applicants by acquisition channel, product, and risk tier — and price accordingly Identify emerging fraud patterns and respond with targeted policy changes Work cross-functionally with US product and marketing teams to balance growth and risk Write SQL to investigate, model, and monitor — no waiting on a data team Requirements (Non Negotiable) - 3+ years of experience in online consumer lending, BNPL, or a tangential fintech/e-commerce credit environment - Hands-on acquisition/top-of-funnel risk experience: risk tier assessment, underwriting sequencing, or dynamic acquisition pricing - Fluent English — interviews, daily standups, and all written communication are in English - SQL proficiency — comfortable writing queries independently to analyze credit performance data - Ability to work US Central Time hours (approx. 9am–6pm CT / 11am–8pm Brasília) Nice to Have - Experience with rescue lane management or near-miss recovery programs - Background in fraud risk within the acquisition funnel - Exposure to multi-path underwriting logic or decision engine configuration - Portfolio monitoring and credit loss forecasting (post-acquisition) - Experience at an e-commerce, marketplace lending, or embedded finance company What We Offer - PJ/contractor arrangement — compensation aligned with fintech market rates - 100% remote — work from anywhere in Brazil - US Central Time schedule — structured workday, no late nights - Direct exposure to a fast-growing US online lending operation Quick Self-Screen In your last role: were the majority of credit decisions made automatically, within seconds, for individual consumers (not companies)? Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento. Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento. Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente. title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - OptimisationJoin or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
